liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Black Peter** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it the year's best Black Peter, and it gets very intense; Reviewer singles out Black Peter and New Speedway Boogie as superb renditions [9][16]
- **The Other One** (1 other source): Tape cuts out during the second verse, likely just before a segue into the Cryptical reprise [1]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): Around the 10:15 mark, a jam grows out of The Eleven, then moves into a sweet We Bid You Goodnight and a quick Alligator [11]
- **Alligator** (1 review): Alligator unexpectedly turns into The Eleven, then returns in shortened form leading to Caution and Feedback [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **We Bid You Goodnight Jam**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd69-12-30.sbd.cotsman.14037.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 169 min; rated 3.67/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Pretty good soundboard quality overall, though it has some bad cuts; Sound is somewhat rough; adjusting the EQ helps; Uploader says this soundboard is on the muddy side [1][5][11]
- **gd1969-12-30.sbd.unknown.4575.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 174 min; rated 3/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Described as a high-quality soundboard [16]
- **gd69-12-30.sbd.miller.28469.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 162 min; rated 3.8/5 by 15 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates this soundboard A+ quality; Reviewer judges it the better of the two circulating sources for this date [8][10]
- **gd1969-12-30.sbd.unknown.15372.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 174 min; rated 2.57/5 by 7 [4]

## Around the show

- Overlooked because it sits in the shadow of the classic New Year's Eve 1969 show the next night [8]
- Reviewer prefers this show to the following night's [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-12-30.sbd.cotsman.14037.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by T.S. Cotsman and J. Cotsman; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Uploader thinks the lineage may go further back than what is known [1]
- **gd1969-12-30.sbd.unknown.4575.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Unknown; source: SBD>?>DAT>CDR [2]
- **gd69-12-30.sbd.miller.28469.sbeok.shnf**: source: Recording Info: SBD -> Cass Master (Ampex C-90 Master Cass/no dolby) -> Cass (Tascam 122mkIII Cass 1st Gen) -> Dat (Technics 3800/44.1k) Transfer Info: Dat… [3]. Also: Charlie Miller worked on this source [10]
- **gd1969-12-30.sbd.unknown.15372.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Unknown; source: SBD>MC>C>D>CD>SHN [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Crimson Records: [GRATEFUL DEAD - Boston Tea Party '69, December 30 - Crimson Records](https://crimsonrecords.com.ar/product/grateful-dead-boston-tea-party/) [18]
